services.name: Fishing Rods
services.desc: Kenai Drift Anglers offers World-class Alaska Salmon Fishing Charters on the Kenai & Kasilof River. In fact, we’re located in Soldotna, Alaska just minutes away from the start of your next fishing trip. So you want to go salmon fishing in Alaska? You’ve came to the right place, in fact Kenai Drift Anglers has delivered top Alaska salmon fishing charters, for years. It’s no secret, the Kenai River holds many records, from the World Record King Salmon “Les Anderson 97 LBS” to the largest road accessible Sockeye salmon Run in the world, averaging 2.8 Million Sockeye salmon a season. With all the awards over the years, it’s truly put the Kenai River as the Salmon epicenter of the world; however
